settings.heading: Overview
settings.body:
Engineered for accuracy, durability, and compatibility with a wide range of probing systems, SemiProbe tungsten probe tips are built for precise electrical measurements and microcircuit testing. High-quality tungsten delivers hardness, conductivity and wear resistance for demanding work in semiconductor, microelectronics and materials research environments.

Each box contains 10 precision-milled probe tips, available in radii from 1 µm for high-resolution probing up to 25 µm for more robust testing. Please call or email SemiProbe if other materials or sizes are required.

settings.heading: Choosing a Configuration
settings.bar_text: Probing sub-micron features, or need a tip material we do not list?

settings.title: START WITH FEATURE SIZE
settings.description: Match the tip radius to the smallest pad or trace you need to contact. Finer radii of 1 µm to 5 µm suit high-resolution probing on small structures; 10 µm to 25 µm give a more robust tip for bond pads and larger test structures.

settings.title: BALANCE RESOLUTION AGAINST TIP LIFE
settings.description: A finer radius contacts smaller features but wears faster and is more easily damaged by overtravel. Where your pads allow it, the larger radius will survive more touchdowns and hold its geometry longer.

settings.title: ASK IF YOU NEED SOMETHING ELSE
settings.description: The radii listed here are tungsten, which covers most DC and low-frequency probing. If your application calls for another material or a radius outside this range, contact SemiProbe and we will quote it.

settings.question: How many probe tips come in a box?
settings.answer: Every part number on this page is a box of ten precision-milled probe tips. The price shown is for the complete box, not an individual tip.

settings.question: Which radius should I choose?
settings.answer: Match the radius to the smallest feature you need to probe. Radii from 1 µm to 5 µm suit high-resolution work on small structures, while 10 µm to 25 µm give a more durable tip for bond pads and larger test structures. See the selection guidance above.

settings.question: Are other materials available?
settings.answer: The tips listed here are high-grade tungsten. SemiProbe can supply other materials and sizes on request — call or email us with your application and we will quote it.

settings.question: Do these tips fit my probe arms?
settings.answer: They are designed for use with SemiProbe manipulators and positioners and fit a wide range of probe stations and probe arms. If you are probing with a non-SemiProbe arm, send us the details and we will confirm fit before you order.

settings.heading: Need a Tip Geometry That Isn't Listed?
settings.body: SemiProbe manufactures probe tips in other materials, radii and custom geometries for proprietary test environments. Tell us your pad size, probing force and measurement type and we will quote the right tip.
